about_zh: 浏览器里跑的一切，从前端框架到后端服务。

repos.description: 🌈谷粒-Chrome插件英雄榜, 为优秀的Chrome插件写一本中文说明书, 让Chrome插件英雄们造福人类~  ChromePluginHeroes, Write a Chinese manual for the excellent Chrome plugin, let the Chrome plugin heroes benefit the human~ 公众号「0加1」同步更新
repos.summary_zh: 本项目开源，专注为优秀Chrome插件编写中文说明书，利用docsify构建文档站点并托管于GitHub Pages。内容涵盖广告屏蔽、视频下载、翻译等实用插件，旨在降低使用门槛，让插件真正造福用户，提升浏览体验。
repos.summary_en: This open-source project provides Chinese manuals for outstanding Chrome extensions. It leverages docsify to build a documentation site hosted on GitHub Pages, covering extensions for ad blocking, video downloading, translation, and more, aiming to empower users and enhance browsing efficiency.

repos.description: 收集免费的接口服务,做一个api的搬运工
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库系统整理了大量免费、实用的Web API接口，涵盖加密算法、天气查询、AI大模型、生活服务等多个领域，每月定时更新。核心价值在于为开发者提供便捷的API集成方案，降低开发成本，加速项目迭代，是开发者快速获取免费接口资源的实用工具库。
repos.summary_en: This repository systematically collects a wide range of free and practical Web APIs, covering encryption, weather, AI models, and daily services, with monthly updates. It provides developers with a convenient API integration solution, reducing development costs and accelerating project iteration, serving as a practical toolkit for quickly accessing free API resources.

repos.description: PanSou是一款高性能的网盘资源搜索API服务，支持TG频道和插件搜索。系统设计以性能和可扩展性为核心，支持多频道多插件并发搜索、结果智能排序和网盘类型分类。docker集成前后端，一键启动，开箱即用。仅供学习研究，请勿以各种形式用于盈利目的。 https://t.me/s/webhtv
repos.summary_zh: PanSou是一款高性能网盘资源搜索API服务，支持TG频道和插件并发搜索。采用工作池设计，实现多源并发与智能排序，自动分类网盘类型。内置异步插件系统与二级缓存，提升搜索效率。Docker一键部署，开箱即用，适用于学习研究。
repos.summary_en: PanSou is a high-performance cloud storage resource search API service that supports concurrent searches across Telegram channels and custom plugins. It features a worker pool design for multi-source concurrency, intelligent sorting, and automatic categorization of cloud drive types. With an asynchronous plugin system and two-level caching, it significantly improves search efficiency. Docker deployment enables one-click setup, ideal for research and learning.

repos.summary_zh: Stremio Web 是官方网页端媒体中心，采用 React 界面与 Rust 编译为 WebAssembly 的核心引擎，实现高性能流媒体播放。支持插件扩展、多设备同步、投屏、字幕及键盘控制，可安装为 PWA，提供跨平台视频娱乐体验。
repos.summary_en: Stremio Web is the official web-based media center, featuring a React UI and a Rust-to-WebAssembly core engine for high-performance streaming. It supports addon expansion, multi-device sync, casting, subtitles, keyboard controls, and PWA installation, delivering a cross-platform video entertainment experience.

repos.description: 🔥 今日热榜 API，一个聚合热门数据的 API 接口，支持 RSS 模式 及 Vercel 部署 | 前端页面：https://github.com/imsyy/DailyHot
repos.summary_zh: 聚合多平台热点数据的轻量级API接口，支持JSON与RSS格式，提供哔哩哔哩、微博、知乎等数十条热榜数据。响应迅速，部署简便，适用于数据抓取、热点追踪及个性化RSS订阅服务。
repos.summary_en: An aggregated hot trends API supporting JSON and RSS formats, pulling real-time data from major platforms like Bilibili, Weibo, Zhihu, and Douyin. Lightweight, fast, and easily deployable on Vercel, perfect for developers building custom feeds or tracking viral topics.

repos.description: 资源站,影视资源站与采集站聚集和收集平台。实时监控全网主流影视类、视频类采集联盟的播放源、视频源接口可用性支持libretv，moontvplus，maccms等
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是一个零服务器、零成本的全自动影视资源站可用性实时监测平台。通过Python定时采集API数据，结合GitHub Actions实现健康检查与统计，并生成可视化JSON数据面板部署至Pages，助力快速筛选高质量播放源。
repos.summary_en: A zero-server, zero-cost, fully automated monitoring platform for video resource stations. Utilizing Python to fetch API data, it integrates with GitHub Actions for scheduled health checks and statistics, generating visual JSON dashboards on GitHub Pages to help filter high-quality playback sources.
